description_en: Cancels an SQL Pattern comparison report
description_zh: 取消 SQL Pattern 对比报告
name: CancelSqlPatternCompareReport

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The AnalyticDB for MySQL instance ID
parameters.help_zh: AnalyticDB for MySQL 实例 ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The SQL Pattern comparison report ID
parameters.help_zh: SQL Pattern 对比报告 ID
parameters.name: report_id

CancelTime.description_en: The time when the report was first canceled. The time is in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
CancelTime.description_zh: 首次取消时间。UTC 格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

Canceled.description_en: Indicates whether the report is canceled. The value true is returned when the report is successfully canceled or canceled again
Canceled.description_zh: 是否已取消。成功或重复取消时返回 true

ReportId.description_en: The SQL Pattern comparison report ID
ReportId.description_zh: SQL Pattern 对比报告 ID
